title: Norn metric record, version 1
description: One measurement, appended once to metrics/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl on the metrics branch and never edited. Every value says what limits it (caveats), where it ran (env) and on what work (workload).

id.description: Unique across the store. A producer that can re-send the same measurement (a CI sweep) picks a deterministic id so the second append is a no-op; otherwise record.py derives one from the content.

metric.description: Stable dotted series id, e.g. fork.create.p50, sim.cell.serial_s, ci.core.task.test.rest-1.s. A series keeps one unit and one statistic forever; a new definition gets a new id.

statistic.description: single: one observation. Percentiles and mean/median/min/max/stddev summarize `samples` observations. total: a sum (e.g. a whole serial suite).

range.description: The spread the source reported for this value across repeated runs (value lies inside it).

commit.description: The commit measured. sha is null only for a backfill whose source names no commit; caveats then say so.

ref.description: What the sha is, e.g. main, PR #1223 head.

recorded_at.description: When record.py appended it; also picks the month shard.

name.description: Lane, job or person, e.g. L-dst, ci.core, metrics-nightly.

url.description: CI run or thread that did the measuring.

runner.description: Only boat series are ratcheted; hosted runners are recorded but too noisy to gate on.

workload.description: What was run: fork counts, test filter, thread count, cases.

caveats.description: What limits the number: noise, method, what it does not cover.

estimate.description: True when the source gives an approximate value.

noise_pct.description: Run-to-run spread the producer measured, in percent of value.

url.description: PR, comment, run or thread holding the measurement.

quote.description: The source's words, for backfilled values.
